messages:
elaine: Quick sync — proposing a canonical 'Tenant Health & Policy Directory' that maps tenant SLA, routing policy, allowed regions, and fallback behaviors. This should be the single source of truth for PM roadmap, infra routing templates, and sales commitments. @raj @kevin @sophia any immediate concerns?

raj: +1. We need a minimal machine-readable schema first. My sketch: tenant_id, sla_tier, allowed_regions, fallback_policy, batching_profile, kv_cache_priority. Keep it terse to start.

kevin: Agree with the fields. Also add capacity_reservation (for Dedicated) and egress_controls (for residency/legal). Need to decide how to encode canary vs auto-failover semantics — boolean + policy_version?

sophia: For launch criteria I propose: 1) schema and API defined, 2) console surfaces mocked and validated, 3) automated failover tests in sandbox, 4) telemetry coverage (latency/cost/eviction signals). Without the telemetry we can't verify decisions.

annie: Add model_aware fields: model_variants, quant_profile, cold_kv_behavior. Will help Optimize recommendations and prevent quality regressions when routing to cheaper variants. Also link a field to prompt/eval sets so we can tie regressions to routing changes.

elaine: Draft milestone suggestion: Q2 — spec + API proto, Q3 — internal pilot (EU+NA, 2 tenant slices), Q4 — customer pilot + docs. Is that realistic capacity-wise?

raj: Q3 pilot looks doable only if we scope: EU+NA and 2 tenants (one hosted, one dedicated). Hard deps: routing templates, policy-enforcement API, console mapping. I'll call out schema + example payload as first deliverable.

kevin: Blockers from infra: cross-region KV consistency for prefix caching, cost accounting per-tenant when routing crosses capacity tiers, and rollout automation for canary by tenant slice. Ops needs a playbook for soft-eviction and fallback.

sophia: UX ask: add a 'routing preview' in console that shows predicted latency/cost delta (estimates) when changing a tenant's policy. That will help sales and SREs sign off on cutovers.

opsbot: Deploybot: PR #4821 (policy-api) will expose /v1/policies and basic schema. Target merge in 2w. Will post build/status. :gear:

elaine: Good. Action items: 
- raj: produce minimal JSON schema + 2 example tenant records by EOW
- kevin: list infra gaps + rough effort estimate for cross-region caching and tenant cost accounting by next Tue
- sophia: mock console panel + routing-preview copy by next Wed
- annie: prepare eval prompt sets to validate quality across model_variants by end of sprint
- opsbot: attach PR #4821 to roadmap epic and post updates

raj: I'll add an example now: ```{ "tenant_id": "acme-123", "sla_tier": "gold", "allowed_regions": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"], "fallback_policy": "regional-fallback:v1", "batching_profile": "low-latency", "kv_cache_priority": "high", "model_variants": ["gpt-small","gpt-medium"], "quant_profile": "q4_8bit" }```

kevin: Nice. One more: capacity_reservation: {"type":"dedicated","gpu_count":4,"min_rps":200} — we'll need to standardize and reference infra resource IDs.

elaine: Thanks team. We'll sync next Tue in the roadmap slot to review schema and infra gap list. If anyone needs a different cadence ping me. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sophia: +1, will add a short user story for sales-facing copy.

annie: I'll queue eval runs against acme-123 sample and report latency/quality delta across variants.

opsbot: Note: incident-bot detected no active incidents. Routing policy epic created: RW-2314.

elaine: Closing thread for now — will capture notes in the epic and ping for reviews. Thanks! :raised_hands:
